name: Aschaffenburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, red and white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Aschaffenburg (a bishop between two towers on red).
history: Municipal flag of Aschaffenburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Aschaffenburg arms — bishop between towers on red
